prohibited_inputs: Source names, source row IDs, train/test flags as model features
Reference energy, error/rank or reference-quality diagnostics
Any candidate DFA energy as a predictor feature
selection: Preserve source VSS train/test flags. Minimize training-only five-fold formula-group CV selected-method MAE. Select descriptor among density_mean/density_mean_std on training CV only; geometry is a matched diagnostic comparator.
fixed_baseline: Argmin mean absolute error on complete VSS training rows only; method-ID lexicographic tie break
target: 45 method absolute errors; train-fold-only StandardScaler for each target; choose argmin predicted error without absolute-value or zero-clipping postprocessing
input_scaling: Ridge uses training-fold-only StandardScaler; trees do not use input scaling
evaluation: The frozen v2 models are evaluated on these same 58 VSS final records. CSD is not read or evaluated by this v2 candidate. Deterministic repetitions check reconstruction and runtime agreement; final scores do not select the model or descriptor.
diagnostic_uncertainty: 2000 paired cluster bootstraps grouped by exact formula, seed 20260930; descriptive pilot intervals only, no claim of independent chemical-family generalization
limitations: Public source targets and previous construction results were inspected; this is not a pristine LLM holdout.
The 175-row subset is conditional on source convergence/spin checks, HFX-curve cleaning, feature availability and complete-method/cross-task eligibility.
Current training/final elemental-formula groups are disjoint; formula grouping is conservative and does not certify distinct chemical families or canonical chemical identity.

All-VSS array association is supported by source identifiers and network-group-code sequences; raw wavefunction coordinates and actual-element atom order have not been independently checked for every VSS record.
Only archived approximate DLPNO-CCSD(T0) values are scored; full PNO/grid/custom-exchange source recipes and fresh wavefunction regeneration remain incomplete.
The original 181-channel descriptor/model is not reproduced.
Two PBE0-state SCFs and prior geometry preparation are required in the source workflow; fresh end-to-end cost or computational saving is not measured.
Density-versus-fixed and density-versus-geometry paired bootstrap intervals span zero; superiority is not established.
P1/P5 final records can overlap; they are related tasks.
density_choice: PBE0 chosen before performance measurement because its archived VSS coverage (348) exceeds B3LYP (235) and SCAN0 (323).
inputs: XYZ element symbols and coordinates in angstrom
Supplied total charge and source-comparison low/high multiplicities
116 archived raw atom-local PBE0 density-difference power-spectrum channels
normalization: Undo original all-VSS atom-type mean/std. New ridge input scaling and per-method target scaling are fitted only on each training fold. Trees see raw pooled features.
pooling: For each actual element in fixed ELEMENTS order: atom count and channel means; mean_std also includes per-channel population standard deviations. Append to the same geometry/charge view.
CSD: Excluded entirely from this VSS-only candidate; previous construction diagnostic is archived separately.
cross_task: Exclude every whole-complex elemental formula present in released P2/P3 graphs, without target-dependent selection. Final P5 source train=0 rows also share no formula with P1 training/development.
cohort: 175 author-generated VSS records: 117 source-training and 58 source-test rows; no training/test elemental-formula overlap. P1/P5 final records can overlap; these are related tasks, not independent chemical datasets.
source_preselection: The retained subset is conditional on the source SCF/convergence and spin-contamination screening, source HFX-curve cleaning, archived density availability, finite reference and all 45 method gaps, and the cross-task formula exclusion. The source density notebook first requires a finite cleaned PBE HFX25 gap. Its upstream curve-cleaning notebook iteratively removes a point if omitting it changes the interpolating VSSE-versus-HFX spline by more than 5 kcal/mol. These source filters are not a new selection by this recommender's final error; their chemical selection bias is retained.
mapping_evidence_limit: For all VSS inputs, the source structures.csv identifiers, atom counts, network-group-code sequence and zero padding were checked against the same-named archived XYZ records. Because P/N, S/O and Cl/F share source group codes, this does not independently certify permutations within a group, exact actual-element atom order, or every original wavefunction coordinate. The sole archived CSD example independently matches actual element order, geometry and the source two-state wavefunction metadata, but remains a local diagnostic and is not redistributed or extrapolated to every VSS record.
state_definition: Each supplied low/high multiplicity pair uses formal ionic d-count metadata with the two-state comparison convention stated in Duan et al., arXiv:2207.10747, Methods / Data set construction: d3/d7 doublet-quartet, d4/d6 singlet-quintet, and d5 doublet-sextet. In particular, the archived d4 LS state is a singlet by source convention; this is not a general claim about the lowest octahedral d4 spin state. The source high-spin multiplicity and total-electron parity are checked independently of gap signs. The gap convention is E_HS(R_HS)-E_LS(R_HS), comparing these two source-defined states in every method/reference; no ordering of other spin states is certified.
